detection.reproduce: cd innovatex-t3-coastal-plastic && bash components/detection/data/fetch_data.sh && cd components/detection && /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.11 -m t3det.prepare && curl -sSL -o ../../.data/detection/weights/yolo11n.pt https://github.com/ultralytics/assets/releases/download/v8.3.0/yolo11n.pt && T3DET_DEVICE=mps nice -n 10 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.11 -m t3det.train --model yolo11n.pt --device mps --imgsz 640 --epochs 100 --time 0.9 --batch 8 --workers 2 --cache disk --name baseline_yolo11n_640 && IMGSZ=640 T3DET_DEVICE=mps bash run_after_train.sh A ../../.data/detection/runs/baseline_yolo11n_640/weights/best.pt
detection.eval_settings.ap: ultralytics COCO-style 101-point; P/R at ultralytics' max-F1 confidence
detection.training.total_wall_clock_note: trainer process start to exit: dataset cache build + training + ultralytics' final val of best.pt; includes any guard pauses
detection.training.recipe: yolo11n.pt (COCO-pretrained, ultralytics assets v8.3.0) fine-tuned on the TUD-GV grouped train split (969 images). ultralytics 8.4.12 defaults (SGD/AdamW auto, mosaic 1.0 with close_mosaic 10, warmup 3 epochs, hsv/flip augmentations) except: batch 8, workers 2, cache=disk, seed 42 deterministic, wall-clock budget `time` (ultralytics re-plans epochs and the LR schedule to fit). best.pt = best val fitness. MPS runs use the CPU label-assigner patch (README A3); NMS time limit lifted.
